title: REGRESSION NM-3162 — Editor panel does not clear on non-HTML column select; stays visible and repositions vertically
stepsToReproduce: Open Terms and Conditions for office 1604 with US English filter.
Click a Left Column (HTML) cell on any row — the editor panel opens.
Click the Name column (non-HTML) on the same or a different row.
Observe: the editor panel remains visible and repositions its Y-coordinate to track the active row.
expectedBehavior: When a non-HTML column (Name or Language) is selected, the RTE editor panel should clear and close. NM-3162 was a closed ticket specifying this behaviour.
actualBehavior: The editor panel does NOT clear or close. It stays visible and repositions vertically to track the active row, in both directions (HTML→Name and Name→HTML) and under rapid alternation. The panel geometry is consistently 312x120px across all 5 alternation states. N=4 independent runs confirmed the regression. Screenshots: nm3162-run1-after-name-click.png, nm3162-run4-rapid-alternation.png. This is a REGRESSION against closed ticket NM-3162.
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-08-06 by tnc-walk-evidence-r1 (4 independent runs). boundingBox geometry 312x120px confirmed in all states. DOM inspection: .tiptap element remains in DOM with visible boundingBox after non-HTML column selection. Evidence: walk-evidence-terms-conditions-2026-08-06.md §NM-3162 Verdict.
baselineEvidence: Old site has no shared RTE panel (each cell is inline editable). The shared panel is new-site-only. The clearing behaviour was specified and closed under NM-3162. This is a regression against that closed ticket.
